context: Teacher and teen student wrap up the term with reflective advice
purpose: Teach: とくに/きわめて/あくまで/どんなに/仮に/たいへん/だんだん/なぜなら

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さくらさん、一年間たいへんよく頑張りましたね。とくに後半の伸びは素晴らしかったですよ。
lines.en: Sakura, you worked tremendously hard all year. Especially your growth in the second half was wonderful.
lines.style: Warm closing remarks delivered with proud teacherly affection

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。でも数学だけはきわめて苦手で、最後まで自信が持てなかったです。
lines.en: Thank you. But math alone was extremely hard for me, and I never got confident with it.
lines.style: Sheepish admission spoken with downcast honest hesitation

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なぜなら基礎の部分を飛ばしてしまったからですよ。だんだん積み上げれば、必ず追いつけます。
lines.en: That's because you skipped the foundations. Build it up gradually and you'll definitely catch up.
lines.style: Gentle diagnostic explanation with patient encouraging conviction

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 仮に毎日三十分だけ復習したら、来年までに間に合いますかね…?
lines.en: If I reviewed just thirty minutes a day, would I make it in time by next year...?
lines.style: Tentative bargaining question with hopeful upward inflection

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: どんなに小さな積み重ねでも、半年あれば景色が変わりますよ。あくまで自分のペースで構いません。
lines.en: No matter how small the accumulation, in half a year the view will change. Strictly at your own pace is fine.
lines.style: Reassuring teacherly wisdom with steady measured warmth

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、最後にひとつだけ聞いていいですか。先生はどうして教師を選んだんですか?
lines.en: Sensei, can I ask one last thing? Why did you choose to become a teacher?
lines.style: Curious sincere question with softening end-of-term affection

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 誰かの可能性をきわめて近くで見られる仕事だからです。さくらさんの来年も、楽しみにしていますね。
lines.en: Because it's a job where you can see someone's potential extremely up close. I'm looking forward to your next year too.
lines.style: Heartfelt personal answer closing with quiet teacherly pride
